Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the intro from the conference — Helix AI would like to explore a formal referral/reseller arrangement with Redwood. We integrate Helix copilots into analytics tooling vendors and see a lot of overlap with Redwood's customer base (SaaS companies in data-heavy verticals).

High-level ask: a simple referral credit + optional reseller model where we can resell Redwood Dedicated for customers we manage. Key questions for us: commission tiers, lead registration mechanics, whether leads we introduce get co-sell support, and how payments are handled.

Attached a short product deck for context (helix-product-deck.pdf).

Would you be open to a short sync next week?

Best,

Thanks — following up with a proposed operational framework so we have a concrete starting point. Quoting Jordan below for context: 

On Mon, Jun 22, 2026 at 10:03 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Anna — thanks for the deck, looks promising. Happy to run through a couple of program options...

Proposed partner ops (draft):

1) Program types
   - Referral: Helix registers an introduced lead, earns referral credit on first closed ARR.
   - Reseller: Helix resells Redwood Dedicated/Private and invoices customer; Redwood provides partner discount and co-sell support.

2) Commission / margin
   - Referral tiers (on first-year ARR): 8% up to $100k ARR, 12% $100k–$500k, 15% > $500k.
   - Reseller margin: standard partner discount 20% off list, with accelerator to 25% for >$250k ACV.

3) Lead registration and qualification
   - Introduced = Helix submits lead through the Partner Portal (or HubSpot form) with supporting evidence (email thread, MQL PDF).
   - Registration window: registered for 90 days pending qualification; if customer closes after 90 days and Redwood had active engagement (sales activity logged), commission subject to review.
   - Disqualifiers: prior active opportunity in Redwood CRM, self-sourced lead by Redwood within 30 days.

4) Tracking and payments
   - Use HubSpot partner record + unique tracking code per partner.
   - Payment terms: net 45 from Redwood invoice to partner for referral; reseller payouts net 60 after customer payment to Redwood.
   - Clawback: 12-month clawback for cancellations/credits.

5) Legal / onboarding
   - Quick MOU to capture high-level economics, followed by a rev-share appendix to Redwood's existing Partner MSA.
   - Pilot clause: 3-month pilot with defined acceptance criteria; pilot credits can be applied toward first invoice.

I've attached a spreadsheet that maps the commission tiers and simple math examples (partner-commission-sheet.xlsx).

Questions for Helix: do the tiers and the 90-day registration window work for you? Any feedback on the reseller margin/discount approach?

Marissa Cole
Director, Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Anna Park <anna@helix.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 08:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Intro: Helix x Redwood — partnership discussion

Thanks for the clear draft, Marissa. A few items from our side: 

- Tiers look reasonable but would prefer referral window of 120 days for cold introductions and 12 months for warm introductions where we have a thread showing prior contact.
- For co-sell credit: if Helix sources and actively participates in the sales cycle (demo, scoping), we'd ask for a co-sell uplift of +3% on the referral credit for the first year.
- Reseller margin: 20% is okay to start; would like clarity on whether Helix can invoice the customer directly (we prefer direct billing for managed accounts).
- EMEA exclusivity: we don't need exclusivity broadly, but would like first-refusal on named accounts where we have an existing relationship.

Also — can Redwood share the MSA rev-share appendix draft? We can get legal involved after we align on ops.

Best,
Anna Park
Head of Partnerships | Helix AI
